title: A Starfish Eats by Pushing Its Stomach Outside Its Body

scenes.text: A starfish eats with its stomach outside its body.
It pushes its stomach out through its mouth and wraps it around its food.
It can pry open a clam with its tube feet and slip its stomach inside the shell.
Then it digests the soft meat right there, outside its own body.
When it is finished, it pulls the stomach back in.
A stomach that goes for a walk.

description:
A sea star can push its stomach out through its mouth to engulf and digest food outside its body.
It can pry open a clam with its tube feet and slip the stomach inside the shell.
What is the weirdest eater you know?
first_comment: Most sea stars have five arms but some have up to fifty. Which animal should we cover next?
